Chapter 6316: Goldclad Skywave

Chapter 6316: Goldclad Skywave

The imperial auras became frozen by the team, looking like majestic waves of ice in the air. It didn’t stop and froze Goldclad Emperor’s dao laws as well.

However, he mustered more power and melted his golden affinity: “Goldclad Skywave!”

His aura took on a liquid form, melting the ice beam as a result. The air became filled with steam from ice being melted.

“They’re so strong!” Many disciples couldn’t believe their eyes.

“That viper is one of the fiercest creatures, the ancestors’ dao came from watching it.” An ancestor murmured in a daze.

“Clank!” The viper still had enough energy to fly upward, wanting to jump into Star Ocean.

The links of the chains became unstable and twisted, unable to hold on for much longer. The two emperors didn’t like this development since they didn’t know if they could keep the viper under control.

Keep in mind, the viper had swallowed an emperor of the world’s canopy level before.

“Letting it escape will be disastrous!” The ancestors gasped upon arriving.

If the two emperors couldn’t suppress it, Desolate Frontier would face massive casualties and destruction.

“Retreat!” Alch-deer and Huntblade focused on the evacuation.

“Enough!” A thunderous roar erupted and a palm descended.

Ten realms appeared among the firmaments, blessing the palm with incredible power.

“Bam!” The ground sank despite numerous seals and augmentations.

Disciples looked over and saw a handsome youth surrounded by the realms. His thoughts could give birth to all things. He looked as unbeatable as could be.

“Ten-realm Emperor!” Many disciples bowed upon seeing him - the strongest emperor of Desolate Frontier. Only the ancient ancestors were stronger than him.

He was a member of the Chen, rumored to be the next candidate to accept the legacy. He was on the limit path, mere steps away from obtaining a primal anima.

“Bam!” The three heads of the viper were nearly crushed and the beast became disoriented.

“Seal!” Goldclad and Lostmetal took advantage of this and pulled the chains harder.

The chains became resplendent with imperial light, fully covering the viper.

“Boom!” It was finally dragged back to the peak for a full seal. Escaping became impossible.

“Ancestor Ten-realm is unbeatable!” Spectators were overwhelmed with admiration.

“Ancestor!” They kneeled in reverence.

For many sects and kingdoms, meeting emperors was a rare thing. However, this didn’t apply to Desolate Frontier.

For example, Alch-deer was in charge of Myriad Peaks, spending his time teaching disciples. This was a privilege unavailable to other cultivators.

However, Ten-realm was an apex emperor and rarely appeared just like the other primal ancestors, hence their excitement.

Ten-realm glanced around for a bit before disappearing.

“Bam!” Another violent smash came from Star Ocean.

Everyone could see a massive figure falling but didn’t know what was going on. Nevertheless, a strand of power pierced through the dimensions and invaded Desolate Frontier.

This single strand alone suffocated even desolate gods and emperors
